title: Vehicle Spec and Trim Level
summary: Feedback on vehicle specification centers on generally good standard or sport trim equipment, with some complaints about limited availability, blurred trim differentiation, and orders not matching expected spec.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car for a good or high specification, including well-equipped standard and M Sport trims.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize limited available specification and the lack of distinction between lower trims and the top-spec M135.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention assumed, lower-than-expected, or mismatched specification, but the short excerpts do not make the overall sentiment clear enough to classify confidently.

limitations: Many excerpts are very short or lack enough context to determine whether mentions of specification are approving or critical.
Several undetermined fragments discuss different issues such as assumed spec, lower perceived trim, and ordered configuration mismatch, so the topic is somewhat heterogeneous.
